subtitle: Azure Synapse to Microsoft Fabric Migration
executive_summary: Meridian Logistics runs its analytics on an **Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pool** fed by Azure Data Factory, with data landing in ADLS Gen2 from SAP S/4HANA, Manhattan WMS and the TMS shipment APIs. The platform was built by a previous vendor, documentation is limited and several stored procedures carry critical business logic.

Cloud4C proposes to migrate this estate to **Microsoft Fabric**, moving 84 pipelines, 36 notebooks, 210 tables and 140 stored procedures onto a Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse. The approach re-platforms what can move as is and refactors procedures only where Fabric requires it, which keeps risk and effort under control.

The migration runs over twenty weeks and ends with a four week parallel run with daily reconciliation, so Synapse is decommissioned only after Meridian signs off on matching results. Purview will be rescanned against the new estate so lineage and the catalog stay current.

objectives.text: Retire the always-on Synapse dedicated pool in favour of shared Fabric capacity.

objectives.lead: Migrate with no loss of logic
objectives.text: Move every pipeline, table and stored procedure with documented mapping and test evidence.
Run Synapse and Fabric in parallel with daily reconciliation before cutover.
Repoint all 18 Power BI datasets to Fabric with no change for report users.
Produce the inventory, mapping matrix and runbooks the current platform lacks.
Rescan the new estate in Purview and rebuild end-to-end lineage.

scope_intro: The scope covers assessment, migration, validation and cutover of the Meridian analytics platform from Azure Synapse to Microsoft Fabric.

scope_sections.title: Assessment and Migration Planning
items: Automated inventory of ADF pipelines, linked services, notebooks, tables and procedures
Complexity scoring of each stored procedure and dependency mapping
Wave plan grouping objects by source system and business domain
Reconciliation approach and test strategy sign off

scope_sections.title: Fabric Environment Setup
items: Fabric workspaces for Dev, UAT and Prod in Southeast Asia
Capacity sizing recommendation (indicative, confirmed after assessment)
Entra ID groups, workspace roles and Key Vault integration

scope_sections.title: Migration Execution
items: Re-platform 84 ADF pipelines to Fabric Data Pipelines
Migrate 36 Spark notebooks with library and runtime updates
Move 210 tables into the Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse with history
Convert 140 stored procedures to Warehouse T-SQL, refactoring to notebooks only where needed

scope_sections.title: Validation and Cutover
items: Row count, checksum and KPI level reconciliation per wave
Four week parallel run with daily reconciliation reports
Cutover runbook, rollback plan and Synapse decommission checklist

scope_sections.title: Power BI and Governance
items: Repoint 18 Power BI datasets and validate key reports with business users
Purview rescan of the Fabric estate with rebuilt lineage

rows.notes: Import retained where Direct Lake does not fit

out_of_scope: New data sources or new reports
Changes to SAP S/4HANA, Manhattan WMS or TMS
Redesign of the existing data model beyond what migration requires
Procurement of Fabric capacity or licenses
assumptions: Meridian will provide admin access to the Synapse workspace, ADF and ADLS
Synapse remains available and unchanged until cutover
Business users are available for report validation in each wave
Object counts stay within ten percent of the inventory shared
Any change in scope will be handled through a formal change request
logical_architecture: In the target state, sources continue to land through Fabric Data Pipelines into OneLake. The Lakehouse holds the raw and curated zones while the Fabric Warehouse replaces the dedicated pool for the serving layer, and Purview covers catalog and lineage.
data_flow: **Ingestion**: pipelines pull SAP, WMS and TMS data into OneLake on the existing schedules
**Bronze**: raw data lands in the Lakehouse as Delta tables
**Silver and Gold**: notebooks and Warehouse T-SQL apply the migrated business logic
**Serving**: the Fabric Warehouse replaces the dedicated pool for reporting
**Consumption**: Power BI datasets are repointed to Fabric
**Governance**: Purview scans the new estate and rebuilds lineage

architecture_layers.components: SAP S/4HANA, Manhattan WMS, TMS APIs

timeline.intro: The migration is planned over twenty weeks in waves, followed by a parallel run and cutover.

stages.activity: Wave 1: SAP finance and procurement objects
Power BI repointing and Purview rescan

conclusion: We thank Meridian Logistics for the opportunity to propose this migration. As an Azure Expert MSP, Cloud4C brings proven migration accelerators and a disciplined reconciliation approach that protect business continuity through cutover.
We welcome the chance to walk through this proposal and answer any questions.
open_questions: Confirm whether any stored procedures are called by systems outside Synapse
